syllabus_metadata.title: Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education
syllabus_metadata.subject: Physics

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts
competences.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explain the concept of Physics (Meaning, branches and connection with other disciplines)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm different physical phenomena (natural and man-made) in their environment in relation to Physics
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups through the use of ICT to come up with the meaning and branches of Physics
Field trip: Organise field trips to help students to explore the applications of Physics in real life experience
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Concept of Physics is clearly explained

learning_activities.activity: (b) Discuss the contribution of Physics to the development of modern society
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the contributions of Physics in the development of modern society
ICT-based learning: Guide the students through different Online sources and web-based information to explore contributions of Physics in the development of modern society
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Contributions of Physics to the development of modern society are clearly discussed
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Balls, conical pendulum, banked road, whirling water in bucket, telescope, solid object, Earth globe, calipers or rulers, jug, F1-10 hydraulics bench and stopwatch

learning_activities.activity: (c) Explain concepts of physical quantities (fundamental and derived quantities) and their SI units
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on measurable objects found in their environment
Jigsaw: Guide students through Jigsaw method to measure the size of various objects assign the SI Unit of the measured quantities
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The concepts of physical quantities are clearly explained
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Tape measure, vernier caliper, stopwatch, protractor, beam balance, magnetic compass and force gauge

learning_activities.activity: (d) Describe concepts of linear motion (speed, velocity, acceleration, distance, and displacement)
teaching_learning_methods: Circle the sage: Guide students through circle-the-sage to explore the concept of linear motion
Questions and answers: Facilitate the students through questions and answers on the real-life applications of linear motion
ICT based learning: Guide students through the use of interactive simulations to visualize the concept of linear motion
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The concepts of linear motion are clearly described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: String, bob, fixed point, smooth table surface, single pulley, springs, masses and online resources

learning_activities.activity: (e) Explain the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power and energy
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power and energy
ICT based learning: Guide students through the use of interactive simulations to visualize the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power, energy
Questions and answers: Use questions and answers to guide students explaining the principle related to force, density, pressure, power and energy
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power and energy are explained clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Water tank, basin, different liquids, solid materials, worksheet, online resources, spring balance and video

learning_activities.activity: (f) Deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating
teaching_learning_methods: Experimentation: Guide the students to perform an experiment to deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating
ICT-based learning: Guide student through the use of different online sources and web-based information to explore principles related to density, sinking and floating
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The relationship between density, sinking and floating is correctly deduced
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Water tank, sinking objects, worksheets, stone, dry wood, picture of floating and sinking objects and online resources

learning_activities.activity: (g) Describe the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy
teaching_learning_methods: Think-ink pair share: Guide the students through Think ink pair share to explore the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy
Group discussion: Organize students in manageable groups to discuss different terms related to mechanical properties of matter
Experimentation: Guide the students through experiment to investigate the relationship between various mechanical properties of matter
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, power and energy are explained clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Metal rod, wooden rod, spring and masses, liquid (water), different shapes and sizes container, glass jar with cork and rubber band

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts
competences.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate mastery of basic terminologies, measurements and symbols in Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe various instruments used for measurement in Physics
teaching_learning_methods: Circle-the-sage: Guide students through circle-the-sage strategy to describe various instruments used for measurements in Physics
Project work: Facilitate the students to describe various instruments used in Physics measurement
Virtual lab experiment: Facilitate the students through the use of Virtual lab to perform experiments to measure various objects
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Measuring instruments used in Physics measurements are correctly described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Online resources, flow-tube, thermometers, stopwatch, retort stand, vernier calliper and steel balls of varying diameters

learning_activities.activity: (b) Relate measuring instruments to physical quantities
teaching_learning_methods: Practical work and experimentation: Guide the students through practical work and experiment to measure different physical quantities by using appropriate instruments
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Precision and accuracy of measurements are clearly related

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts
competences.specific_competence: 1.3 Use mathematics to explain physical principles and phenomena

learning_activities.activity: (a) Use mathematical knowledge to describe relationship between various physical quantities (force, velocity, acceleration, density, pressure)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organize students in manageable groups through the use of mathematical knowledge to describe the relationship between various physical quantities
Problem solving: Guide the students to use physical principles to solve real life problems
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The mathematical knowledge is used to describe the relationship between various physical quantities
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Online resources and Physics reference books

competences.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of basic experimental skills in Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Conduct experiments related to linear motion, density, force, pressure, work, energy, power and mechanical properties of matter
teaching_learning_methods: Experimentation: Guide students through experiments to investigate the relationship between various parameters related to linear motion, density, force, pressure, work, energy, power and mechanical properties of matter

ICT based learning: Facilitate the students through the use of virtual lab, to investigate the principles related to linear motion, density, force, pressure, work, energy, power and mechanical properties of matter
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Experiments are properly conducted following the scientific method
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Online resources, Small masses, meter rule, stop watch, trolley model calipers, wooden and metal rods, balances, string and pulley

competences.specific_competence: 2.2 Demonstrate mastery of data analysis, presentation and report writing in Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explain the methods of analysing experimental data in physics (statistical analysis)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in groups to investigate various methods used to analyse experimental data in physics (statistical analysis)
ICT based approach: Guide students through the use of ICT to investigate the best methods for analysing experimental data in Physics (statistical analysis)
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The methods of analysing experimental data are explained correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Data and Online resources, Physics reference books

learning_activities.activity: (b) Use analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Facilitate the students to brainstorm on the analytical methods used to manipulate experimental data in physics
ICT based approach: Guide students in utilizing interactive digital simulations to explore the hands-on activities for analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics are correctly performed
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Data and Online resources, Physics reference books

learning_activities.activity: (c) Use graphical method to present experimental results in physics
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Facilitate students through the use of graphical method to present experimental results in physics
Use of ICT facility: Guide students in utilizing interactive digital simulations and other software to present the experimental results using graphs
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The graphical method to present experimental results in physics is clearly used
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Data and online resources, Physics reference books and different graph papers

competences.main_competence: 3.0 Evaluate and use information in Physics
competences.specific_competence: 3.1 Collect, describe and relate physical data

learning_activities.activity: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical quantities (density, force, pressure)
teaching_learning_methods: Cooperative learning strategy: Guide students to share their understanding on how to collect and analyse data to explain various physical parameters (density, force, pressure)
Project work: Facilitate students to do projects to collect, analyse data and explain various physical parameters (density, force, pressure)
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The data used to explain various physical parameters are collected and analysed appropriately

learning_activities.activity: (b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
teaching_learning_methods: ICT based approach: Guide students in utilizing interactive digital simulations to collect analyse data and explain experimental observations related to linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
Experimentation: Guide students in manageable groups to conduct experiments and analyse collected data
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The physical data to explain experimental observations related to given concepts are appropriately collected and analysed

competences.main_competence: 3.0 Evaluate and use information in Physics
competences.specific_competence: 3.2 Carry out a project in Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Develop prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles and laws gained from the field of linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organize students in manageable groups to discuss the procedure for the development of prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles and laws gained from the field of linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
Problem based approach: Guide students to relate the designed prototypes and real life
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Prototypes are developed based on Physics

sections.title: Contribution of Physics to the development of modern society
